non_retroactivity: DO_NOT_CHANGE_FROZEN_V255_OR_ANY_ALREADY_HASH_FROZEN_UNIVERSE; annotate only unless a separate correction receipt invalidates frozen science
objective: Strengthen causal-hypothesis construction, universe completeness, semantic dedupe, independent signal parity and execution parity before economic scoring.

external_engine_roles.signal_oracle: May independently rematerialize frozen signals from the same frozen specification and data; may not alter configuration space.
external_engine_roles.execution_oracle: Consumes frozen event anchors plus ordered Bid/Ask data and returns trade ledger; may not generate or rank signals.
external_engine_roles.research_sandbox: May explore only inside a separately preregistered campaign with its own genealogy and exposure state.

universe_rules.fixed_point_scope: A RISE fixed point proves closure only inside the preregistered causal genealogy radius, never universal strategy-space exhaustion.
universe_rules.interaction_depth: Depth must be justified ex ante by the causal mechanism. Larger depth is not authorized merely to search more combinations.
universe_rules.parameter_surface: Neighborhoods and boundary points used later for plateau/sensitivity analysis must be frozen before economic results.
universe_rules.semantic_normalization: Remove only proven no-op representation differences, normalize commutative ordering, and preserve a reversible alias map.
universe_rules.exact_mask_dedupe: Exact event-mask equivalence may collapse aliases pre-PnL; near-equivalence may only be annotated, not removed or excluded from N_TESTS unless separately proven exact.
universe_rules.cross_genealogy: Exact semantic/event collisions with prior genealogies must be classified as alias/descendant/collision before economic scoring.

metamorphic_backtest_tests: FUTURE_TRUNCATION_INVARIANCE: removing ticks after decision time cannot change an already-issued signal
COST_MONOTONICITY: increasing explicit cost with identical fills cannot improve net_R
SLIPPAGE_MONOTONICITY: adverse slippage with identical path cannot improve entry/exit economics
TIMESTAMP_ORDER_STABILITY: equal timestamps respect carrier_sequence deterministically
BAR_RESAMPLE_CAUSALITY: a bar/MTF feature cannot include quotes after its declared close
BID_ASK_SIDE_INVARIANT: BUY uses Ask entry/Bid exit; SELL uses Bid entry/Ask exit
NAIVE_OPTIMIZED_PARITY: optimized and reference implementations match trade-by-trade on bounded fixtures
